executiveProfile.title: Executive Profile: The AI-First Architect
executiveProfile.hook: "Most AI never reaches production." I take systems from an empty repository to a running service — schema, queues, auth, tenant isolation, deployment, cost control — and I write the postmortem when they break.
executiveProfile.paragraph1: I am a Senior Software Engineer and Gen-AI Architect based in Berlin, working with teams across the EU. With a dual background in Applied Computer Science and Industrial Engineering from HTW Berlin & TU Berlin, I bridge technical delivery and the business case behind it.
executiveProfile.paragraph2: At Accenture Germany I build Spring Boot / Java microservices for Fortune 500 banking and automotive clients on OpenShift and Google Cloud. In parallel, under AI Waverider, I have designed, built and operated my own portfolio of production systems — multi-tenant SaaS on Next.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL and BullMQ, with RAG, vector search, multi-provider LLM routing, agentic pipelines and per-request cost accounting.
executiveProfile.paragraph3: What I bring: full end-to-end ownership — tenant isolation guarded by four independent mechanisms, an 8-language localisation system with a build-failing completeness gate, and GDPR right-to-erasure implemented as a tested user journey. I work in English day to day, and add German C2 and native Arabic where a team needs the reach.
executiveProfile.whyDubai: What I'm looking for: a senior engineering, architecture or tech-lead role with an EU-based team — remote-first or hybrid — that is putting Gen-AI into real products. No visa, no sponsorship, no relocation paperwork: a German passport means I can start anywhere in the EU/EEA.

products.title: Selected Products & Platforms
products.subtitle: Designed, built and operated end-to-end — 23 self-authored production systems, ~5,900 commits.

omnalu.name: Omnalu (FlowState)
omnalu.desc: Desktop AI where the audio and the screen index never leave the machine: GPU Whisper transcription with Metal/CUDA/Vulkan backends chosen at runtime, ScreenCaptureKit system-audio capture so both sides of a call are transcribed on headphones, a Swift Vision-OCR screen timeline linked into the Rust binary over a hand-written C ABI, and meeting output exported as DOCX or slides. Includes a patched upstream crate applied via [patch.crates-io] to kill a nil-pointer panic on display wake.
omnalu.stack: Rust · Tauri · Swift · whisper.cpp · Deepgram · ScreenCaptureKit · Vision OCR

emailai.name: Reply Autopilot
emailai.desc: Multi-tenant email automation: 108 data models, 171 migrations and 20+ BullMQ workers. Tenant isolation is enforced by four independent mechanisms — a runtime query guard, an ESLint rule, a static audit script and a dedicated CI job. Ships a full deliverability control plane: SPF/DKIM/DMARC checking, DMARC aggregate-report ingestion with p=none→quarantine→reject escalation, Google Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS reputation, mailbox warmup and a reversible per-domain cutover.
emailai.stack: Next.js · PostgreSQL/Prisma · BullMQ/Redis · Qdrant · Gmail API · Microsoft Graph · IMAP/SMTP

leadoutbound.name: Lead Outbound AI
leadoutbound.desc: Live lead-generation platform. Five discovery providers — Apollo, Hunter, Google Places, OpenStreetMap and Instantly — normalised behind one lead type, with score-gated enrichment that refuses to spend credits on low-value leads. Per-provider USD cost accounting caught a real billing bug (Hunter charges per email returned, not per call). AI company research uses Gemini with live Google Search grounding. Multi-tenancy is enforced by 32 Postgres row-level-security policies rather than application code.
leadoutbound.stack: Next.js · Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS · Apollo · Hunter · Google Places · Gemini grounding

contentfactory.name: Content Factory
contentfactory.desc: Multi-tenant content production platform. Remotion renders video programmatically, ElevenLabs voiceover drives beat-level timing so cuts land on sentence boundaries, HeyGen supplies per-beat avatars and Vertex AI generates stills. Three quality gates refuse to ship broken output — an ffprobe check on audio and drift, and a vision model that rejects captures containing cookie banners or paywalls. Per-brand encrypted credentials, spend caps, and a byte-level render-parity test over rendered frames.
contentfactory.stack: Remotion · Node.js · ElevenLabs · HeyGen · Vertex AI · MinIO/S3 · PostgreSQL

ralph.name: Ralph — Autonomous Coding Loop
ralph.desc: An autonomous coding control plane where the agent cannot certify its own work. Story selection is deterministic and owned by the shell, not the model; a story only passes with a machine-verifiable proof receipt; a quality ratchet makes the passing count mathematically unable to decrease; four typed circuit breakers stop runaway spend; and blocked runs escalate to a human decision inbox. It drove a 114-story backlog to 112 passing and produced a 346-commit production application.
ralph.stack: Bash · Node.js · Claude Agent SDK · SSE · proof receipts · quality ratchet

zelavi.name: Zelavi
zelavi.desc: Tele-therapy marketplace built to a regulated standard. Contract-first: 96 OpenAPI operations map one-to-one to routes and to a generated Dart client, and the typecheck itself fails if they drift. Per-conversation AES-256-GCM keys are derived with HKDF and the API has no decrypt function by design. GDPR right-to-erasure is implemented as a tested end-to-end user journey. On-device person-segmentation blur for video calls fails closed — no mask means the whole frame blurs.
zelavi.stack: NestJS · PostgreSQL/PostGIS · Flutter · LiveKit · Stripe Connect · 8 languages, 2 RTL

wavecode.name: Wavecode
wavecode.desc: A multi-provider agentic coding client: eight providers and 27 models behind one tool loop, with an embedded browser the agent drives by numbered element badges rather than guessed pixels. Local-model capabilities are read from Ollama at runtime instead of inferred from the model name, and the context slider computes per-token KV-cache RAM before a model is ever loaded. Four silent model substitutions were found and killed, each locked out by a mutation-checked test.
wavecode.stack: Rust · Tauri 2 · Ollama · MCP · ACP · OpenAI · Anthropic · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen

wavecut.name: AI WaveCut
wavecut.desc: AI video-editing studio shipped as a signed macOS installer, with a tiered licensing and device-activation system: HMAC-signed keys, per-tier device limits, PBKDF2 key derivation from a device fingerprint and remote activation. A parallel C++17/Qt6 rewrite — 15 hand-written GLSL shaders including eight transitions, and FFmpeg linked through its C API rather than shelled out. Shipped as code and a written migration audit; the Qt build is not yet packaged.
wavecut.stack: Tauri · React · Python · C++17/Qt6 · FFmpeg C API · GLSL · faster-whisper

translatepro.name: Social Automation Platform
translatepro.desc: A multi-app platform, not a single tool: an Instagram automation suite (keyword triggers, conversation flows, workflows, A/B tests, interactions and analytics — 11 modules), an AI translation pipeline with word-level timestamps, and separate music, video and thumbnail generation, over a Google Drive ingestion pipeline. Publishing goes to YouTube and Instagram — the YouTube resumable-upload protocol is implemented by hand (session initiation, chunked transfer, processing-status polling) rather than wrapped from an SDK. 40 registered modules, 18 queues, Stripe billing, with a React web client and an Expo mobile app.
translatepro.stack: NestJS · BullMQ · PostgreSQL · Instagram Graph API · YouTube Data API · Whisper · Stripe · React · Expo

storefront.name: aiwaverider.com
storefront.desc: Storefront and content platform: dual payment rails (Stripe and PayPal), a RAG chatbot answering from the live catalogue over a Qdrant index, twelve transactional email templates, automated video ingestion from YouTube and TikTok on a cron schedule, first-party analytics, and a documented Firestore-to-PostgreSQL migration with eight numbered SQL migrations. Publishes a curated library of 5,600+ n8n automation workflows.
storefront.stack: React · Node.js/Express · PostgreSQL · Redis · Qdrant · Stripe · PayPal · Firebase

clinicai.name: ClinicAI
clinicai.desc: A fully offline clinical retrieval system — every network call in the codebase goes to localhost and no AI-vendor SDK exists in the tree. Documents are OCR'd with Tesseract, chunked paragraph-aware at 700 characters with a 120-character overlap tail, embedded locally and stored L2-normalised so a dot product is cosine similarity. Answers stream token by token from a local model with clickable citations back to the exact source text, and generate watermarked PDF and DOCX drafts.
clinicai.stack: Python · FastAPI · Ollama (gemma3 · nomic-embed-text) · Tesseract · NumPy · WeasyPrint

laborsynopse.name: Laborsynopse
laborsynopse.desc: German-language clinical laboratory analysis. Five LLM providers behind one proxy with per-call cost and token auditing, and a scan pipeline that never lets a model do arithmetic: units and reference ranges are resolved deterministically from two independent signals that must agree, or the row is flagged rather than guessed. Literature is re-screened for retractions against two independent sources and fails closed. Output is deliberately scoped as a Verdachtsdiagnose — a hypothesis for a clinician to check, never a diagnosis.
laborsynopse.stack: Next.js · PostgreSQL/Prisma · OpenAI · Anthropic · Kimi · DeepSeek · GLM · PubMed · Crossref
